caption: The video showcases a close-up view of a parked motorcycle's right side, focusing on the engine and front wheel assembly. A bronze exhaust header loops prominently near the finned cylinder head, which sits above the black crankcase. The chrome 'Street' script logo is clearly visible on the oval side cover to the right. The front wheel features a drilled disc brake and is held by a telescopic fork with black rubber gaiters. Throughout the clip, the camera executes a slow, steady move to the right. This movement causes the motorcycle to drift gradually leftward within the frame, revealing more of the seat and rear cover on the right edge. The background, consisting of a pale corrugated wall and concrete ground, shifts at a much slower rate, creating a distinct parallax effect. The round mirror at the upper left also moves leftward as the framing slides, while the motorcycle itself stays in place with no wheel rotation or visible engine vibration. The relative positions of the bike's components stay constant as the camera explores the details of the machine, with the framing still in motion as the clip concludes.
